create_ApplyAttentionMask: create an ApplyAttentionMask layer from a mask tag and masked out value to apply causal attention masks to logits
build_Attention: build an Attention layer with five sublayers for queries, keys, values, attention weights, and output computation
build_KVCachingAttention: build a KVCachingAttention layer that adds key-value caching for autoregressive inference
create_KVCachingAttention_from_uncached: create a KVCachingAttention from an existing Attention layer with cache length and sequence axis configuration
run_Attention_call: run an Attention layer forward pass by calling it with a NamedArray input to compute queries, keys, values, and output
